statements.t: We plan to achieve the mission by maintaining and strengthening our market position and brand in the cosmetic medical treatment management market in Japan, Vietnam and Singapore, and by growing our presence globally.

To the extent additional funds are necessary to meet our long-term liquidity needs as we continue to execute our business strategy, we anticipate that they will be obtained through the incurrence of indebtedness, equity financings or a combination of these potential sources of funds.

While we face uncertainties regarding the size and timing of our fundraising, which will be affected by general economic, financial, and other factors that may be beyond our control, we believe that we will be able to continue to meet our current business needs through the use of cash flows generated from operations.
The Company expects to deploy capital for investment opportunities that align with its growth strategy, selectively pursuing prospects in the expanding global medical aesthetics market.

We will remain a smaller reporting company unless, as of an applicable annual determination date, (i) the market value of our common stock held by non-affiliates is $250 million or more and (ii) either our annual revenues are $100 million or more or the market value of our common stock held by non-affiliates is $700 million or more.

statements.t: We aim to raise productivity and profitability at the clinics we support while expanding the network efficiently.

Together, these initiatives are intended to improve profitability at existing clinics and make new clinic openings more efficient, enabling our scalable MSO platform to generate greater earnings power as the business expands.

By adding diagnostics to our existing medical network and combining AI with physicians’ expertise, we aim to build an integrated platform spanning testing, personalized treatment and evaluation of outcomes.
In Japan, we will continue expanding our multi-brand presence in aesthetic dermatology and broadening our non-aesthetic medical services.
We intend to deploy this strong financial position toward disciplined growth investment, with the goal of sustaining EPS growth over the medium- to long-term and enhancing corporate value.”

Additionally, the earnings release, accompanying slides, and a separate link to the archived webcast of this conference call will be available on the Company’s Investor Relations website at https://ir.sbc-holdings.com/.
